mentions.name: Hackerman recorder
mentions.description: This web app provides an infinite coding video/screensaver: pick your IDE, monitor and ambience of choice, hit the Screensaver button, and put it on a second monitor or TV to enjoy commentary-free coding ASMR. A recently added Paper Mode shows an animated quill scrawling across parchment for public domain novels.
mentions.problem: It is surprisingly difficult to find hour+ long coding videos without commentary on YouTube; the author wanted an infinite coding video to play in the background while working.
mentions.audience: Programmers who like having live coding videos playing in the background while they work
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm still working on Hackerman recorder. As a programmer, I really enjoy having live coding videos playing in the background while I work. But it's surprisingly difficult to find hour+ long videos of coding without commentary on Youtube.

What I really wanted was an infinite coding video, so I built one. Pick your IDE/monitor/ambience of choice, hit the Screensaver button, put it on a second monitor or TV, and enjoy infinite coding ASMR.
mentions.author: vunderba
